Privacy information.

How this static website handles your visit and enquiries.

Information We Collect

The enquiry form asks for your name, last name, email address, enquiry type, description, and consent. It prepares a draft in your email application. This website has no form submission endpoint or visitor account system.

How We Use Your Information

If you send an email, DVT receives the information you choose to include for responding to your enquiry. Do not include passwords or sensitive personal information.

Disclosure of User Information

Opening an email draft uses your configured email application and provider. Hosting providers may process technical request information under their own terms. No analytics scripts are included.

External Resources

Fonts are requested from Google Fonts. Your browser may share technical request information with that provider. The office photograph is stored locally and is illustrative.

Changes to This Privacy Information

This notice describes the current static website. Company-wide retention, data rights, and disclosure terms should be supplied and reviewed before publishing a final corporate privacy policy.

Privacy Contact

Email careers@dvtworld.com for privacy enquiries.
